selection_basis: Derek requests uniform 0.24 mm layers throughout the complete faucet, including the first bed layer. Selected seams, localized cooling and edge supports are retained.

overhang_recipe.scope: Part cooling is off on ordinary paths. Force 70% only on bridges and wall paths with at least 50% of their bead width unsupported, after the first three bed layers. No layer-time cooling, auxiliary part cooling or fan pre-start.
overhang_recipe.selection_quote: the cooling, high cooling, is totally fine. We can use 100% cooling if we want, but only on the places that actually need it, and everywhere else we shouldn't be using that cooling.

wall_generators: Retain base Arachne for the continuous reinforced foot; other rigid parts retain Classic.
scope: Selected complete Industrial print recipe with uniform 0.24 mm layers requested by Derek. Prior physical results retain their identified geometry, layer-height and material scope.

rear_seam_enforcement.target: Complete outer rear silhouette at each build Z, including tilted stage shoulders; facets crossing CAD X=0 +/-0.25 mm

tip_rear_seam_enforcement.target: Outer curved neck rear meridian at CAD X=0, excluding plug and display-frame surfaces

base_rim_supports.tree_support_scope: Tree(auto)/Default elsewhere, retaining automatic normal sections. Narrow blockers duplicate the accepted arc contact strips only.
base_rim_supports.selection_quote: Those arc fins snapped off super easy, and they provided excellent support.
base_rim_supports.scope: Transfer the exact physically accepted base-rim support meshes at the retained -15 degree pose. Their local finish and release are accepted; the complete-height project with these supports is unprinted.

edge_support_strategy.selection_quote: I'm quite convinced that we need to do this everywhere, that we've got these rough edges on overhangs.
edge_support_strategy.method: Follow the visible unsupported edge with a removable fin shaped to that edge; use intermittent arcs on curved rims and retain Tree(auto)/Default on the remaining geometry.
edge_support_strategy.application: Use this treatment for the faucet rough overhang edges. The base rim has physical acceptance. Tip lip and other geometry require their own edge placement and an anchored printing start; their physical result is not inferred from the base.

tip_supports.root_contact_scope: Hidden male insertion terminal end only. The directly bonded disc leaves a scuff; do not transfer this bonded contact to visible surfaces.
tip_supports.tree_support_scope: Tree(auto)/Default elsewhere. Retain the accepted joint-plane block paint except the seam-side low lip support enforcers.
tip_supports.selection_quote: That worked. That disc works in this case, and is removable, but it leaves a bit of a scuff that would be a problem on a visible surface, but since its on the male insertion portion that is hidden, we are golden here.

layer_selection_quote: So it's the same layer height throughout the print.
